scope: Three explicitly authorized account aggregates; no identifiers or row contents returned
databaseMode: TLS / REPEATABLE READ READ ONLY / ROLLBACK
query:
WITH requested(label,control) AS (
 SELECT * FROM unnest($1::text[],$2::text[])
), observed AS (
 SELECT r.label,a.id IS NOT NULL AS affiliate_exists,
  a.auth_user_id IS NOT NULL AND u.id IS NOT NULL AS linked_auth_exists,
  a.auth_user_id IS NOT NULL AND u.id IS NOT NULL AND u.email_confirmed_at IS NOT NULL AS linked_auth_confirmed,
  a.id IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS(
   SELECT 1 FROM public.admin_assignments aa
   JOIN public.admin_roles ar ON ar.id=aa.role_id AND ar.enabled
   WHERE aa.auth_user_id=a.auth_user_id AND aa.enabled
  ) AS enabled_admin_assignment_with_enabled_role
 FROM requested r
 LEFT JOIN public.affiliates a ON a.numero_control=r.control AND a.is_archived=false
 LEFT JOIN auth.users u ON u.id=a.auth_user_id
)
SELECT label,
 count(*) FILTER(WHERE affiliate_exists)::int AS non_archived_affiliate_count,
 count(*) FILTER(WHERE linked_auth_exists)::int AS linked_auth_exists_count,
 count(*) FILTER(WHERE linked_auth_confirmed)::int AS linked_auth_confirmed_count,
 count(*) FILTER(WHERE enabled_admin_assignment_with_enabled_role)::int AS enabled_admin_assignment_with_enabled_role_count
FROM observed GROUP BY label ORDER BY label
parameters: Control values omitted; private label mapping remains in ignored workspace

definitions.nonArchived: affiliates.is_archived=false; this is not a certification of employment, affiliation or financial eligibility
definitions.confirmedAuthLink: Existing auth.users row linked by affiliates.auth_user_id with email_confirmed_at non-null; not a session, email-equivalence or certified-link validation
definitions.administrator: At least one enabled admin_assignments row joined to an enabled admin_roles row for the linked Auth user; same predicate as captured admin_support_private.is_active_admin(uuid)

limits: No account identity is selected when zero or multiple non-archived matches exist.
No JWT/session, acting administrator permission, requested amount, debt, loan eligibility, document availability or real submission result was tested.
These aggregates support only the target-account administrator hypothesis at the observation time; they do not link an account to the previously observed log event.
